mechanism: Cognitive Suspension protocol. When two high-confidence inputs conflict (A ⊥ B), the {{agent}} instantiates a {{tension}} object that binds them together. This blocks downstream decision-making until a reconciling insight (Pattern C) is found via {{dialectic}} or {{synthesis}}.
failure_modes: Premature Convergence: {{agent}} resolves {{tension}} by arbitrarily discarding one side to reduce cognitive load.
Tension Blindness: {{agent}} treats a contradiction as a simple error/hallucination and ignores it.
Analysis Paralysis: Accumulating {{tension}} objects without ever triggering {{dialectic}} resolution.
invariants: No Selection: Output cannot be simply 'A' or 'B' (must be {{tension}}{A,B}).
Persistence: {{tension}} object remains active until explicitly resolved via {{synthesis}} or Falsification.
postconditions: Execution flow diverted to Information Retrieval (to break the tie)
